experimental_method: Gas-saturated water at 25 C analysed by bubbling (approach to saturation from low and high pressure) and, at 100/200/300 atm, by a shaking apparatus; apparatus as in the authors' hydrogen work.
uncertainties_stated: Errors (probable error) calculated from E = 0.674 sqrt(sum D^2 / (n(n-1))); listed per row; two methods agree within about 0.1 per cent at 100-300 atm.
quality_remarks: N2 purity about 99.9 per cent (argon and traces of oxygen remain). Table I final value at 50 atm printed 0.374 (probably 0.674, Table III prints 0.674). Temperature scale not stated; temperature 25 C only in title.
not_extracted_tables: Table III: comparison of results of different observers (Frolich estimates from a blue print, Goodman and Krase, this work); duplicates this paper's final values plus literature estimates
extraction_notes: Text layer was garbled (decimal points doubled, +- read as zk); all cells read from the 200 dpi image and a 2x crop. Page is the whole article (single page). No sanity problems except the 50 atm misprint; coefficients monotonic in pressure.
needs_pass2_reason: Text layer unreliable (garbled digits); all cells re-read from image.
pass2_diff: Tables I and II: 11 rows, 90/90 numbers identical; the 0.374 at 50 atm is printed so.
